name: Forgotten...Forever
source:
You ran away from home after a fight with your parents, with nowhere to go you decided to take a nap on a bench. When you woke up, you found yourself tied in a dark place with only a small dim artificial light . Your objective is to just be able to escape.

[From [url=https://rafaanimations.itch.io/forgotten-forever]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与父母吵架后，你离家出走，无处可去，决定在长凳上小憩。当你醒来时，你发现自己被绑在一个黑暗的地方，只有一点微弱的人造光。你的目标就是能够逃脱。

[来自[url=https://rafaanimations.itch.io/forgotten-forever]itch.io[/url]]
